title: Product Bundle Photos for Clearer Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every item in your kit in one square bundle photo. Use it on Amazon, Shopify, gift pages, social ads, and posts without booking another photo shoot.
h1: Product Bundle Photos That Show Every Shipped Piece
lead: Open this kit template and add one photo of the complete kit. Download a square image, or turn it into a short kit video with a spoken voice.
steps_h2: How to Make a Bundle Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Every piece in one photo, then one square file. That photo spends 24 credits. Credits are what your plan spends. Add the price after download, or make a kit video with a script.

steps.d: Upload a clear photo of the full kit, with the box and paper insert. Every piece you ship should be visible.
Name how the pieces sit so each one stays visible. Add a script and a spoken AI voice if you make a kit video.
Download the square image and compare each object with your contents list. Add the price after download.

faq.q: What is a product bundle photo template?
faq.a: A ready setup for the kit you ship. Add one photo of every piece and download a square image. You can also add an AI actor, a spoken voice, and a script for a kit video.

faq.q: How do I make the bundle photo?
faq.a: Upload one photo of the full kit, name how the pieces sit so each one stays visible, and download the square image. You do not need a long note.

faq.q: Why use this instead of a new photo shoot?
faq.a: It starts from the kit photo you already have. You skip lights, a camera, and a new photo setup for every new gift.
Shops, gift brands, and agencies that need a contents view for a listing, a bundle page, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. If every piece is already in the photo, follow the three steps. If you also make a video, set captions, a song, and an AI voice in the editor on this site.

faq.q: Can one photo show every item?
faq.a: Yes, when each piece is visible and the full set fits in the frame. The image should not add a piece that was not in the photo.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photos and clips?
faq.a: Yes. Use a photo file (JPG, PNG, or WebP) of the complete kit, or a short clip you have the rights to. Keep the box and the paper insert in the photo when they ship.

faq.q: Where can I publish the file?
faq.a: The photo is square, for a product gallery. A video of the same kit can be tall (9:16), square (1:1), or wide (16:9). The 4:3 size is a bit wider than tall, and 3:4 is a bit taller than wide. Publish it to TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, or YouTube in one step.

faq.q: What does a bundle photo cost?
faq.a: Credits are what each photo or video spends. Each product photo costs 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. If it fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I use the image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, which means no logo is stamped on the file. They can run in your own ads, pages, and posts. You remain responsible for the contents and any claims.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link, many kits at once, or my own software?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the kit product link for a script and a voice copied from one you may use. Or run many kits at once (a batch), or send them from your own software (the API). Add the current price in your editor after download. The same photo can be used for another language.
